summary: Ian O'Brien, 28, of Page AZ texted his partner at ~6:30pm after summiting Hesperus Peak and failed to return to camp at Echo Basin; 12,000+ acres searched by Montezuma County SAR, ground/air teams, drones, USAF HH-60W helicopters; official search suspended Jun 28, volunteer search ended Jul 11; remains found September 2023.
location: Hesperus Mountain / Echo Basin, La Plata Mountains (east of Mancos)
responding_agency: Montezuma County Sheriff's Office, Montezuma County SAR, USAF 58th Special Operations Wing
notes: Last contact 6:30pm Jun 24; reported missing 12:30am Jun 25; O'Brien had epilepsy and a GPS unit; outcome fatality (presumed; never located). Montezuma County OEM July-2023 situation report: MCSAR responded 6/25/23 to Echo Basin/Hesperus Peak; after 4 operational periods (ground teams, dogs, ATVs, mutual aid, multiple air resources) the search was suspended pending further information; friends/family continued searching until Jul 9; search placed in "limited continuous mode"; a second turned-around hiker was assisted back to his vehicle by a diverted search team during the operation. Resolution 2026-09-15: Grand Junction Daily Sentinel reports the search was called off July 2023 and his remains were found in September 2023.
